info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Assignments Reassign API

params.name: id
params.description: An UUID representing the assignment id.

params.name: assigneeid
params.description: An UUID representing the id of the new assignee.

items.docs: Reassign the assignment with the given id to the new assignee.

params.name: from_assigneeid
params.description: An UUID representing the assignee id.

params.name: to_assigneeid
params.description: An UUID representing the reassignee id.

items.docs:
Reassign the assignments of the first assignee id to the assignee with the second id.
The assignees can be users or teams.
The assignments will be updated if:
  • the current user is regular and the assignments are assigned to him or his teams
  • the current user is queue manager and and the assignments have an assignee in the current branch or child branches
  • the current user is in the same branch as the reassignee
